verses.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.pt: Certamente minha alma se aquieta por causa de Deus; dele vem minha salvação.
verses.en_web: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David.> My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my salvation.

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.pt: Certamente ele é minha rocha, minha salvação e meu refúgio; não serei muito abalado.
verses.en_web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.
verses.en_bbe: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

verses.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.pt: Até quando atacareis um homem? Todos vós sereis mortos; sereis como um parede tombada e uma cerca derrubada.
verses.en_web: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.en_bbe: How long will you go on designing evil against a man? running against him as against a broken wall, which is on the point of falling?

verses.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.pt: Eles somente tomam conselhos sobre como lançá-lo abaixo de sua alta posição; agradam-se de mentiras; falam bem com suas bocas, mas amaldiçoam em seus interiores. (Selá)
verses.en_web: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Their only thought is to put him down from his place of honour; their delight is in deceit: blessing is in their mouths but cursing in their hearts. (Selah.)

verses.en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, ó minha alma, aquieta-te em Deus; porque ele é minha esperança.
verses.en_web: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
verses.en_bbe: My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my hope.

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.pt: Certamente ele é minha rocha, minha salvação e meu refúgio; não me abalarei.
verses.en_web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
verses.en_bbe: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

verses.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.pt: Em Deus está minha salvação e minha glória; em Deus está minha força e meu refúgio.
verses.en_web: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.en_bbe: In God is my salvation, and my glory; the Rock of my strength, and my safe place.

verses.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.pt: Confiai, povo, nele em todo o tempo; derramai vosso coração diante dele; Deus é nosso refúgio. (Selá)
verses.en_web: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Have faith in him at all times, you people; let your hearts go flowing out before him: God is our safe place. (Selah.)

verses.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.pt: Pois os filhos dos seres humanos são nada; os filhos do homem são mentira; pesados juntos são mais leves que o vazio.
verses.en_web: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
verses.en_bbe: Truly men of low birth are nothing, and men of high position are not what they seem; if they are put in the scales together they are less than a breath.

verses.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.pt: Não confieis na opressão, nem no roubo; nem sejais inúteis; quando tiverdes bens, não ponhais neles vosso coração.
verses.en_web: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
verses.en_bbe: Have no faith in the rewards of evil-doing, or in profits wrongly made: if your wealth is increased, do not put your hopes on it.

verses.en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
verses.pt: Deus falou uma vez; eu ouvi duas vezes: que de Deus vem o poder.
verses.en_web: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
verses.en_bbe: Once has God said, twice has it come to my ears, that power is God's:

verses.en: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.pt: Também é tua, Senhor, a bondade; pois tu pagarás a cada homem conforme sua obra. Salmo de Davi, quando ele estava no deserto de Judá:
verses.en_web: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
verses.en_bbe: And mercy, O Lord, is yours, for you give to every man the reward of his work.
